brief_rationale: The doctor meets all responsibility-chain requirements with no in-chain errors: medication safety boundaries are established, follow-up owners are named, red flags are taught, and an executable plan with teach-back is achieved. Two high-order points are completed with meaningful trajectory impact: HO1 (correcting caregiver misunderstandings about inpatient records vs. home tasks) and HO4 (adapting to real-world constraints with practical prioritization). All five dimensions reach at least good. Closure is valid with explicit confirmation from the caregiver.
